about: Assist abilities per statue (docs/research/19-assists.md §5, §6): ids of the shared dtbattle_ability_data_table rows DT_AST_<kind><tier> (an assist-only statue has its own row DT_AST_<statueId>), with the client's activation conditions ([{statueType, count}] over the seat's assists; empty = always). Built by tools/content/build_assist_abilities.py.

sources.note: statues without wiki assist numbers: the leaning stat at tier rarity - 2; conditions empty
assist-only statues: their own row under their own ABI_AST_<statueId>_N label, values of the kind and tier above
